name: Hokkaidō
focus: Tell ginger from soy sauce, then season a bowl of Sapporo soup curry.
intro: In Sapporo, soup curry has a thin, aromatic broth and large pieces of vegetables. Rice is usually served alongside. Your practice pot starts with a hot, spiced broth.
instruction: 鶏肉、にんじん、しょうがを入れて。
translation: Add chicken, carrot and ginger to the spiced broth.
seasonJP: しょうゆを二回、みりんを一回。
seasonEN: Two small pours of soy sauce and one of mirin.
dietary: Chicken, vegetables and a curry-spiced chicken broth. This practice bowl uses ordinary soy sauce containing soy and wheat, and hon-mirin, an alcohol-containing seasoning. The broth and curry blend vary by maker.
missHigh: Too salty. Check the number of soy pours.
missLow: It needs more umami. Check the soy measure.

technique.english: Hold a low heat to simmer the curry.
technique.done: The broth has soaked into the vegetables.

name: Fukuoka
focus: Build a bowl of mentaiko rice, then turn it into ochazuke with warm dashi.
intro: Hakata is known for karashi mentaiko, chilli-seasoned pollock roe. It is often eaten with rice. In this lesson, finish the bowl ochazuke-style by pouring warm kombu dashi over it.
instruction: ご飯、明太子、のりを入れて。
translation: Add rice, mentaiko and dried seaweed.
seasonJP: だしを二回。しょうゆは入れないで。
seasonEN: Two ladles of dashi. Leave out the soy sauce.
dietary: Rice, seasoned Alaska pollock roe, nori and kombu dashi. Contains fish. The roe marinade can contain soy and wheat. Check the product label. This version uses kelp stock and adds no extra soy sauce.
missHigh: The broth has diluted the roe. Try two ladles.
missLow: There is too little broth. Listen for nikai, twice.

technique.instruction: 温かいだしをご飯にかけて。
technique.english: Pour the warm dashi over the rice.
technique.done: The warm dashi surrounds the rice.

name: Osaka
focus: Listen for cabbage, then dress the pancake with two sauces.
intro: In Osaka, chopped cabbage is mixed into the batter. Slices of pork brown against the griddle.
instruction: キャベツを生地に混ぜて、豚肉をのせて焼いて。
translation: Mix cabbage into the batter. Top with pork and cook on the griddle.
seasonJP: お好みソースを二回ぬって、マヨネーズを一回かけて。
seasonEN: Brush on the okonomiyaki sauce twice. Squeeze mayonnaise over it once.
measureNote: One tap adds one brushful of sauce or one squeeze of mayonnaise.
dietary: The batter contains wheat flour, egg and bonito stock. This pancake has pork, egg mayonnaise and a soy-based finishing sauce.
missHigh: お好みソースが多すぎる。
Too much okonomiyaki sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: お好みソースが足りない。
Add a little more okonomiyaki sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: マヨネーズが多すぎる。
Too much mayonnaise. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: マヨネーズが足りない。
Add a little more mayonnaise. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: へらでお好み焼きをひっくり返して。
technique.english: Flip the pancake with the spatula.

phrase.japanese: お好み焼きをひっくり返す

name: Aichi
focus: Plate a pork cutlet and measure out Nagoya’s dark miso sauce.
intro: Nagoya serves crisp breaded pork with a rich soybean miso sauce. Shredded cabbage sits alongside.
instruction: とんかつとキャベツを盛って、ごまをふって。
translation: Plate the cutlet and cabbage. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
seasonJP: みそだれを二杯かけて、からしを少し添えて。
seasonEN: Spoon over two measures of miso sauce. Put one dab of mustard on the side.
measureNote: One tap adds a spoonful of sauce or a small dab of mustard.
dietary: The pork cutlet is coated in flour, egg and wheat breadcrumbs. The red miso sauce contains soy. Sesame and mustard finish this plate.
missHigh: Too much miso sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more miso sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much Japanese mustard. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more Japanese mustard. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: みそだれをとんかつの上に広げて。
technique.english: Spread the miso sauce across the cutlet.
technique.done: The miso sauce coats the cutlet.

name: Miyagi
focus: Mash sweet green soybeans for Sendai’s zunda mochi.
intro: The green coating on zunda mochi is made by crushing edamame. A little texture is part of its character.
instruction: 枝豆をつぶして砂糖を混ぜ、餅を用意して。
translation: Mash the edamame with sugar. Set the rice cake aside for coating.
seasonJP: 水を一杯、塩をひとつまみ加えて、餅にからめて。
seasonEN: Loosen the paste with one spoonful of water. Add one pinch of salt and coat the rice cake.
measureNote: One tap adds a spoonful of water or a pinch of salt.
dietary: This sweet combines glutinous rice cake, green soybeans, sugar, water and salt. The green coating contains soy.
missHigh: Too much water. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more water. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much salt. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more salt. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: 枝豆をつぶして。少し粒を残して。
technique.english: Mash the beans and leave a little texture.
technique.done: The green bean paste is ready to coat the mochi.

name: Niigata
focus: Dip a thin pork cutlet in sweet soy glaze and serve it over rice.
intro: In Niigata City, thin cutlets are dipped in a sweet soy sauce while still hot. They go straight onto the rice.
instruction: ご飯をよそって、とんかつと、たれ用の砂糖を用意して。
translation: Fill the bowl with rice. Set out the cutlet and the sugar for the glaze.
seasonJP: しょうゆを二回、みりんを一回入れて煮て。とんかつをくぐらせて。
seasonEN: Simmer the sugar with two pours of soy and one of mirin. Dip the cutlet and lay it on the rice.
measureNote: One tap adds a small pour to the glaze.
dietary: This bowl uses pork, wheat breadcrumbs, flour and egg in the coating. The glaze contains wheat-brewed soy sauce, sugar and hon-mirin.
missHigh: Too much soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much sweet rice seasoning. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more sweet rice seasoning. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: とんかつをたれにくぐらせて。
technique.english: Dip the hot cutlet briefly in the glaze.
technique.done: A thin soy glaze clings to the crust.

phrase.japanese: とんかつをくぐらせる

name: Hiroshima
focus: Season oysters and carrot for a pot of Hiroshima oyster rice.
intro: In Etajima, oyster cooking liquor flavours the rice. Local versions of kaki meshi may also include burdock or shiitake.
instruction: 米を用意して、かきとにんじんを鍋に入れて。
translation: Set the rinsed rice aside. Put the oysters and carrot in the pot.
seasonJP: しょうゆとみりんを一回ずつ入れて煮て。煮汁で米を炊いて。
seasonEN: Simmer with one pour each of soy and mirin. Cook the rice in the liquid and fold in the oysters and carrot.
measureNote: One tap adds one small pour to the cooking liquor.
dietary: Oyster liquor seasons the rice. The oysters are molluscs. This version uses wheat-brewed soy sauce and hon-mirin.
missHigh: Too much soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much sweet rice seasoning. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more sweet rice seasoning. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: かきの煮汁で米を炊いて。
technique.english: Cook the rice in the oyster liquor.
technique.done: The rice has absorbed the oyster liquor.

name: Nagano
focus: Make the aubergine and miso filling for a Shinshū dumpling.
intro: Nagano’s oyaki wrap seasonal fillings in thin dough. This version uses aubergine and miso.
instruction: 皮を広げて、なすを切って、みそを用意して。
translation: Flatten the wrapper. Slice the aubergine and set out the miso.
seasonJP: 油を一杯入れてなすを炒め、みそと砂糖一杯を混ぜて。皮で包んで焼いて。
seasonEN: Fry the aubergine in one spoonful of oil. Mix in miso and one spoonful of sugar. Wrap and griddle the dumpling.
measureNote: One tap adds a small spoonful of oil or sugar.
dietary: The wrapper is wheat flour and water. The filling uses aubergine, soybean miso, oil and sugar.
missHigh: Too much oil. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more oil. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much sugar. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more sugar. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: 具を皮で包んで、とじ目を押さえて。
technique.english: Wrap the filling and press the seam closed.
technique.done: The wrapper holds the aubergine filling.

name: Kagawa
focus: Boil the udon, then finish with hot broth and fresh toppings.
intro: Sanuki is the old name for Kagawa. For hot kake udon, boil the noodles, rinse them in cold water and warm them again before adding broth.
instruction: うどんを用意して、ねぎとしょうがを別にしておいて。
translation: Set out the noodles. Keep the spring onion and ginger aside for topping.
seasonJP: 温め直したうどんに、だしを二杯、しょうゆを一回。ねぎとしょうがをのせて。
seasonEN: Add two ladles of broth and one pour of soy to the rewarmed noodles. Top with spring onion and ginger.
measureNote: One tap adds one ladle of anchovy stock or one small pour of soy.
dietary: The udon is made from wheat flour. The broth uses dried anchovies and soy sauce brewed with wheat.
missHigh: Too much stock. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more stock. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: うどんだけを別の鍋でゆでて、湯を切って。
technique.english: Boil just the noodles in a separate pot, then drain.
technique.done: The noodles are drained. Rinse and rewarm them for the broth.

name: Tokyo
focus: Season a clam broth to spoon over rice, Fukagawa-style.
intro: Fukagawa’s fishermen ate clams and spring onion in miso broth over rice. A second local version cooks the clams with the rice.
instruction: ご飯をよそって、あさりとねぎを鍋に入れて。
translation: Fill the bowl with rice. Put the clams and spring onion in a pot.
seasonJP: だしを二杯入れて煮て。みそを一杯溶いて、ご飯にかけて。
seasonEN: Simmer with two ladles of stock. Dissolve one spoonful of miso and pour the broth over the rice.
measureNote: One tap adds one ladle of kombu stock or a spoonful of miso.
dietary: This version uses short-neck clams, rice, spring onion, kombu stock and soybean miso. Clams are molluscs.
missHigh: Too much stock. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more stock. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much miso paste. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more miso paste. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: みそが溶けるまで、だしを混ぜて。
technique.english: Stir the clam broth until the miso dissolves.
technique.done: The miso has dissolved into the broth.

name: Okinawa
jp: ゴーヤーチャンプルー
focus: Stir-fry bitter melon with tofu and egg in an Okinawan pan.
intro: Firm tofu keeps its shape beside the ridged slices of bitter melon. The beaten egg coats both as it sets.
instruction: ゴーヤーと豆腐を炒めて、溶いた卵を入れて。
translation: Stir-fry the bitter melon and tofu. Pour in the beaten egg.
seasonJP: しょうゆを一回、塩をひとつまみ入れて。
seasonEN: Season with one small pour of soy and a pinch of salt.
measureNote: One tap adds one small pour of soy or one pinch of salt.
dietary: This practice pan uses tofu, egg, bitter melon, oil and salt. Its soy sauce contains wheat. Other versions may include pork or bonito flakes.
missHigh: Too much soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more soy sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much salt. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondLow: Add a little more salt. Listen for the measure again.

technique.instruction: 卵が固まるまで軽く炒めて。
technique.english: Stir-fry gently until the egg sets.
technique.done: The egg coats the bitter melon and tofu.

name: Kyoto
focus: Warm tofu with kelp and measure the citrus dip on the side.
intro: Kyoto’s yudōfu gently warms tofu in water with kombu. The seasoning belongs in a small dipping bowl.
instruction: 昆布を敷いて豆腐を温めて。ねぎは小皿に入れて。
translation: Line the pot with kelp and warm the tofu. Put the spring onion in a small dipping bowl.
seasonJP: 小皿にポン酢を二回。しょうゆは入れないで。
seasonEN: Pour ponzu into the dipping bowl twice. Leave out the extra soy sauce.
measureNote: Each tap is one small pour into the dipping bowl.
dietary: Tofu is warmed in kombu water. This version uses a citrus and soy dip made with wheat-brewed soy sauce and no fish stock.
missHigh: Too much citrus dipping sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missLow: Add a little more citrus dipping sauce. Listen for the measure again.
missSecondHigh: Too much soy sauce. Leave it out this time.

technique.instruction: 昆布だしで豆腐を静かに温めて。
technique.english: Warm the tofu gently in the kelp broth.
